title: Page Zero
description: Pages are counted starting from 1 in the tracking table, not 0 — a client that assumes zero-indexing should get a clear rejection, not a confusing empty or duplicated first page.
successCondition: GET /api/tracking?page=0 as a logged-in user returns 400 with error.code VALIDATION_ERROR. GET /api/tracking?page=1 (the minimum, and also the default) returns 200 successfully.
hints: page is validated with a minimum of 1 — 0 fails schema validation before any query runs.
Also try a negative page number as a related boundary check if you have time — it should fail the same way.
